title: ICICI Prudential Mutual Fund gets RBI nod to raise stake in 4 banks to 9.95%- Moneycontrol.com
text:
My Alerts Go Ad-Free Follow us on: The AMC received the go-ahead to raise its holding in four banks — Kotak Mahindra Bank, CSB Bank, DCB Bank and AU Small Finance Bank   September 09, 2026 / 19:35 IST             ICICI Prudential AMC has secured the Reserve Bank of India's go-ahead to raise its holding in four banks — Kotak Mahindra Bank, CSB Bank, DCB Bank and AU Small Finance Bank — to up to 9.95 per cent, according to a regulatory filing issued on September 9. The RBI granted the approvals through separate letters dated September 8, 2026, allowing ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd to acquire an aggregate stake of up to 9.95 per cent of the paid-up share capital or voting rights in each of the four lenders, ICICI Bank — the fund house's parent — disclosed in the filing. As per the terms of the approval, the asset manager must complete the acquisition of the major shareholding within one year from the date of the RBI letters, failing which the approvals will lapse automatically. ICICI Prudential AMC has secured the Reserve Bank of India's go-ahead to raise its holding in four banks — Kotak Mahindra Bank, CSB Bank, DCB Bank and AU Small Finance Bank — to up to 9.95 per cent, according to a regulatory filing issued on September 9.

The RBI granted the approvals through separate letters dated September 8, 2026, allowing ICICI Prudential Asset Management Company Ltd to acquire an aggregate stake of up to 9.95 per cent of the paid-up share capital or voting rights in each of the four lenders, ICICI Bank — the fund house's parent — disclosed in the filing.

As per the terms of the approval, the asset manager must complete the acquisition of the major shareholding within one year from the date of the RBI letters, failing which the approvals will lapse automatically.
